1850 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but also by 100 and not by 400).  
09-02-1850 is February 9, 1850.  
Subtract 194 days:  
Back to Jan 1, 1850: from Feb 9 → 31 days in Jan already passed, so 9 days in Feb → 31 + 9 = 40 days into the year.  
194 days earlier means go back 194 days from day 40 of 1850.  
40 − 194 = −154 days relative to Jan 1, 1850.  
Add 365 days (since coming from previous year 1849): −154 + 365 = 211th day of 1849.  
1849 is not a leap year.  
211th day: Jan 31 (31), Feb 28 (59), Mar 31 (90), Apr 30 (120), May 31 (151), Jun 30 (181), Jul 31 (212) → July 31 is day 212, so day 211 is July 30, 1849.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1849-07-30
